## Install

Install R and Julia 1.10 or later from their official distributions. Install
FIMS and its R dependencies using binary packages when available. FIMS itself
does not compile C++ code or require TMB, Rtools, CMake, or Doxygen. Third-party
R packages may have their own compiled dependencies.

```{r install, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("NOAA-FIMS/FIMS")
library(FIMS)
setup_julia()
```

If Julia is not on PATH, pass its executable explicitly:

```{r runtime, eval=FALSE}
setup_julia(julia = "C:/path/to/Julia/bin/julia.exe")
```

Alternatively, set `JULIA_HOME` to Julia's **bin directory**. Restart R after
changing Julia or R versions.

## What setup does

`setup_julia()` resolves the backend, RCall and Suppressor together and strictly
precompiles them in standalone Julia. Project-scoped RCall preferences bind the
bridge to the selected R without changing other projects' R installations.
Dependencies and configuration are cached under
`tools::R_user_dir("FIMS", "cache")`; the installed R package need not be writable.
First setup requires internet access. Errors include the underlying Julia output.

`library(FIMS)` and `initialize_fims()` do not start Julia. Fitting starts it
lazily. Run setup in a fresh R process before embedding Julia through other
packages, to avoid incompatible already-loaded Julia dependencies.

## Verify the real interface

```{r verify, eval=FALSE}
data <- FIMSFrame(data_big)
input <- setup_default_parameters(data) |> initialize_fims(data)
fit <- fit_fims(input, optimize = FALSE, get_sd = FALSE)
stopifnot(is.finite(get_report(fit)[["jnll"]]))
```

An unoptimized report verifies loading, serialization and model evaluation,
not numerical parity or convergence. A scalar `1 + 1` bridge smoke test alone
does not verify a FIMS model.

## Migrating scripts

Julia is the only backend; omit `backend`, or specify `"julia"`. Retired APIs
include native module constructors, mutable native parameter vectors,
`CreateTMBModel()`, native logging and low-level distribution initializers.
Replace these with the parameter tibble and high-level initialization workflow.
Saved native fits must be refitted before extracting estimates. Native module-ID
JSON is replaced by JSON with `backend`, `estimates` and `report`.

The objective supports parameter-aware functions, gradients, Hessians, reports
and observation simulation. Simulation uses R's RNG, preserves missing values,
and is conditional on random-effect modes rather than drawing random effects.
Use `set.seed()` for reproducible simulation. `clear()` does not invalidate
existing fitted objects.

## Containers and contributing

The repository includes R/Julia Dev Container configurations for VS Code and
Codespaces. For local shell setup, run `bash setup_fims.sh` after installing R
and Julia. No system package manager or native compiler is invoked by that
script for FIMS itself.

Run `devtools::test()` and Julia's package tests. To include real bridge
regressions, set `FIMS_RUN_JULIA_INTEGRATION=true`. CI checks installation and
R CMD check with FIMS compiler commands disabled on supported operating systems.
